title: cicuta virosa var. californica
intro: Cicuta virosa var. californica, commonly known as Western Water Hemlock, is a highly toxic plant native to the western coast of North America. However, it has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Western Water Hemlock include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, although these properties are largely anecdotal and not extensively scientifically studied. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, although the exact composition and effects of these compounds are not well characterized.
